title: Schema Lab: a schema-driven publishing engine for single-author microjournals
description:
Schema Lab is a standalone prototype that proves a design idea: an article can be defined as a schema (a named, ordered list of fields with shape, style, and visibility), and one small set of templates can turn any schema and any article using it into a correct webpage, a matching PDF, and a correct issue listing — without the templates ever hard-coding a field name.

It is intended as a reusable building block for single-author microjournals, practice-update series, or lightweight departmental publications that need consistent dual-format (HTML + PDF) output from simple Markdown + front matter.
